opportunities.name: Company account brief (SEC + Wikipedia + email)
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to a colleague (then discard).
steps: Search ticker in SEC EDGAR company search and select the company
Open Form filter and the 10-K Annual report to get filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open article
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body summarising HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date

instances.values: HUBS / HubSpot, SEC part only observed

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison + local time email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in different currencies to USD on Xe, check the supplier's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement a summary of which is cheaper.
steps: Enter amount and select from-currency, convert to USD
Search supplier city on timeanddate World Clock and read local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Type body with both USD values, cheaper option, supplier local time

opportunities.name: Time zone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find time difference on timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up holidays in the remote country's calendar, and email ops a sync note.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick the remote country
Note holidays in the target month
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: <A> / <B>, <Month>'
Type body with time difference and dates to avoid
